name: Apple Music (Daily 5 & 双语歌词)
author: OmniDesk
description: Reuses qwen-translator Apple Music/Adam/bilingual lyrics modules with CN catalog preflight, gated ChatGPT Daily 5 sync, and MediaSource archive playback.

config_schema.label: Obsidian Vault 本地仓库目录
config_schema.description: Path to local ZJFILOVE/obsidian-vault checkout (optional; falls back to XDG curation repos when unset)

config_schema.label: Music Daily 本地仓库目录
config_schema.description: Path to local ZJFILOVE/music-daily checkout (optional; falls back to XDG curation repos when unset)

config_schema.label: 每日精选累计歌单 ID
config_schema.description: Protected cumulative ChatGPT Daily 5 playlist ID (missing-only append under daily_immutable)

config_schema.label: Apple Music 曲库地区码
config_schema.description: Two-letter Apple Music catalog storefront (Daily 5 & CN preflight strictly enforce cn)

config_schema.label: Apple Music API 基址
config_schema.description: Apple Music API base URL (https://amp-api.music.apple.com or https://api.music.apple.com; loopback allowed for local tests)

config_schema.label: qwen-translator 同源目录
config_schema.description: Sibling qwen-translator directory providing music_adam, music_lyrics, music_service, and music_playback

config_schema.label: 每日歌单检查点路径 (可选)
config_schema.description: Optional explicit path for 0600 daily checkpoint; defaults to XDG_STATE_HOME/daily5/apple-music-playlist.json

config_schema.label: libmpv / mpv 可执行路径
config_schema.description: Executable name or path for mpv playback integration

config_schema.label: 公网 API 代理 (可选)
config_schema.description: Optional HTTP/HTTPS proxy for public Apple Music API calls (loopback always bypasses proxy)

config_schema.label: 启用 LRCLIB 在线歌词回退
config_schema.description: Allow qwen-translator LyricsRepository to query LRCLIB when local/Adam lyrics are absent

config_schema.label: 自动翻译外语歌词
config_schema.description: Allow translating missing Chinese lyric lines when LLM translation capability is available

config_schema.label: Apple Music Developer Token
config_schema.description: Apple Music Bearer developer JWT stored exclusively in 0600 SecretVault

config_schema.label: Apple Music Music-User-Token
config_schema.description: Apple Music Music-User-Token stored exclusively in 0600 SecretVault

config_schema.label: Apple Music 会话 Cookie (可选)
config_schema.description: Optional Apple Music Cookie header stored exclusively in 0600 SecretVault
